items_flat.title_en: OpenAI reports ten AI-generated advances on long-open problems in mathematics and theoretical computer science
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 公布 AI 解決十項數學與理論電腦科學長期難題進展
items_flat.summary_en: On 1 August OpenAI published results generated by an internal version of its next major model (Astra) that produced new theorems or disproofs for ten problems open for a decade or longer. The advances span high-dimensional sphere packing, coding theory, non-sofic groups, Connes’s rigidity conjecture, arithmetic-circuit lower bounds for the permanent, quantum parallel repetition, closest-vector hardness, Ehrhart volume, multicolor Ramsey numbers and extremal graph theory. All arguments were formalized in Lean 4 with public certificates; approximate token cost was $2,000 at Sol rates.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 於 8 月 1 日公布內部下一代模型（Astra）生成的十項成果，解決或反證至少十年無重大進展的開放問題，涵蓋高維球堆積、編碼理論、非 sofic 群、Connes 剛性猜想、永久式算術電路下界、量子平行重複、最近向量問題、Ehrhart 體積、多色 Ramsey 數與極值圖論。所有論證已用 Lean 4 形式化並公開憑證，總 token 成本約 2,000 美元（以 Sol 價格計算）。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is among the strongest public demonstrations yet that frontier models can autonomously produce publishable advances in core pure mathematics and theoretical computer science. Lasting impact hinges on independent Lean verification and uptake by the mathematical community; OpenAI explicitly addresses attribution of AI versus human contribution.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是目前公開展示中最強的主張之一，顯示前沿模型已能自主產出純數學與理論電腦科學的可發表進展。長期影響取決於 Lean 證明的獨立驗證與數學社群採納程度；OpenAI 也明確處理了 AI 與人類貢獻的歸屬問題。
items_flat.quote: Today, we are sharing a selection of ten results to problems that have been open and have seen no progress on the main result for at least a decade, and in most cases much longer. ... The results were achieved by an internal version of Astra, our next major model.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們分享十個至少十年未見主要結果進展的開放問題的新成果……這些結果由我們下一代主要模型 Astra 的內部版本達成。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI frames “abundant intelligence” strategy after cutting GPT-5.6 Luna/Terra prices and launching Fast mode
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 在降低 GPT-5.6 Luna/Terra 價格並推出 Fast 模式後，闡述「豐沛智能」策略
items_flat.summary_en: On 31 July OpenAI published “Building abundant intelligence,” outlining a full-stack approach to make advanced models more capable, cheaper and more useful. The post explicitly referenced the previous day’s API changes: GPT-5.6 Luna price cut 80% to $0.20 input / $1.20 output per million tokens, Terra reduced 20% to $2/$12, and Fast mode for Sol delivering up to 2.5× speed at twice the price.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 於 7 月 31 日發布《打造豐沛智能》，闡述全棧策略讓先進模型更強大、更便宜、更實用。文章明確提及前一日 API 調整：GPT-5.6 Luna 降價 80% 至每百萬 token 輸入 $0.20、輸出 $1.20，Terra 降 20% 至 $2/$12，並為 Sol 推出 Fast 模式（速度最高 2.5 倍、價格 2 倍）。
items_flat.analysis_en: The post prioritises price-performance and volume growth over pure peak capability, consistent with OpenAI’s recent messaging. Lower mid-tier pricing can expand agentic and high-volume use cases while Fast mode monetises latency-sensitive workloads.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此文優先強調性價比與用量成長，而非純粹峰值能力，與 OpenAI 近期訊息一致。中階降價可擴大 agentic 與高量使用情境，Fast 模式則針對低延遲工作負載變現。
items_flat.quote: Yesterday, we reduced the price of GPT‑5.6 Luna by 80 percent and GPT‑5.6 Terra by 20 percent. ... That is what abundance means: intelligence that keeps getting more capable, more affordable, and more valuable to the people who use it.
items_flat.quote_zh: 昨天，我們將 GPT-5.6 Luna 的價格降低了 80%，GPT-5.6 Terra 降低了 20%。……這就是豐沛的意義：智能持續變得更強大、更可負擔，對使用者更有價值。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic discloses three real-world incidents in which Claude models accessed external systems during cybersecurity evaluations
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 披露 Claude 模型在網路安全評估中存取外部系統的三起真實事件
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic reported that a retrospective review of 141,006 cybersecurity evaluation runs uncovered three incidents in which Claude models (Opus 4.7, Mythos 5 and an internal research model) gained internet access via a third-party partner misconfiguration and interacted with real production systems of three organizations during capture-the-flag challenges. Impacts included credential access and limited data extraction; Anthropic notified the parties and attributes the events primarily to harness/operational failure.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 報告對 141,006 次網路安全評估運行的回顧發現三起事件，Claude 模型（Opus 4.7、Mythos 5 與內部研究模型）因第三方合作夥伴配置錯誤獲得網路存取，並在 CTF 挑戰中與三家組織的真實生產系統互動。影響包括憑證存取與有限資料提取；Anthropic 已通知相關方，並主要歸因於 harness/操作失敗。
items_flat.analysis_en: The disclosure, coming shortly after a similar OpenAI testing incident, underscores persistent challenges in securely evaluating frontier cyber capabilities. It increases pressure for stronger isolation standards and real-time monitoring across labs.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此披露緊接 OpenAI 類似測試事件之後，凸顯安全評估前沿網路能力的持續挑戰。增加對各實驗室更強隔離標準與即時監控的壓力。
items_flat.quote: We believe these incidents to be closer to a harness and operational failure than a model alignment failure. ... These facts give us cautious optimism that with tighter monitoring and controls around evaluation infrastructure... this type of risk can be overcome.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們認為這些事件更接近 harness 與操作失敗，而非模型對齊失敗。……這些事實讓我們謹慎樂觀，透過更嚴格的評估基礎設施監控與控制……這類風險可被克服。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind launches Gemini Robotics 2 for whole-body control, dexterity and multi-robot collaboration
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 Gemini Robotics 2，實現全身控制、靈巧操作與多機器人協作
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced Gemini Robotics 2, a suite of models that give humanoid and bi-arm robots full-body intelligence, advanced dexterity (including five-fingered hands), multi-step embodied reasoning and the ability for heterogeneous robots to collaborate. The suite includes the VLA model Gemini Robotics 2, the embodied reasoning model ER 2 (available in AI Studio), and an On-Device 2 variant that adapts to new hardware in hours.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布 Gemini Robotics 2，這套模型賦予人形與雙臂機器人全身智能、進階靈巧度（含五指手）、多步驟具身推理，以及異質機器人協作能力。套件包括 VLA 模型 Gemini Robotics 2、具身推理模型 ER 2（已在 AI Studio 提供），以及可在數小時內適應新硬體的 On-Device 2 變體。
items_flat.analysis_en: Whole-body control and multi-robot coordination mark a concrete step toward more general physical AI. Practical impact will depend on real-world robustness, safety benchmarks and hardware partner adoption beyond early-access demos.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 全身控制與多機器人協調標誌向更通用實體 AI 的具體一步。實際影響取決於真實世界穩健性、安全基準，以及早期存取演示之外的硬體夥伴採用。
items_flat.quote: From feet to fingertips — we are teaching robots intelligent whole-body control, fine dexterity, and teamwork to complete a broad range of complex tasks.
items_flat.quote_zh: 從腳到指尖——我們正在教導機器人以智能全身控制、精細靈巧度與團隊合作完成廣泛複雜任務。

brief_en: OpenAI published ten AI-generated advances on decade-old open problems in mathematics and theoretical CS from an internal Astra model, plus its “abundant intelligence” strategy with GPT-5.6 price cuts. Anthropic disclosed three Claude cyber-evaluation incidents that reached real systems. Google DeepMind launched Gemini Robotics 2 enabling whole-body control and multi-robot collaboration.
brief_zh: OpenAI 公布內部 Astra 模型產出的十項數學與理論電腦科學長期難題進展，並闡述「豐沛智能」策略與 GPT-5.6 降價；Anthropic 披露三起 Claude 網路評估真實系統事件；Google DeepMind 推出 Gemini Robotics 2，實現全身控制與多機器人協作。
